class MockHandler implements InvocationHandler {
   private final Map<Method, Object> stubs = new HashMap<>();

   @Override
   public Object invoke(Object proxy, Method method, Object[] args) throws Throwable {
       // store invocation for when()
       SimpleMockito.lastInvocation.set(new SimpleMockito.Invocation(proxy, method, args, this));
       // if stub exists for method, return it
       if (stubs.containsKey(method)) {
           Object ret = stubs.get(method);
           // support multiple returns: if ret is Queue, poll.
           if (ret instanceof Queue) {
               return ((Queue<?>) ret).poll();
           }
           return ret;
       }
       // default return based on return type
       Class<?> rt = method.getReturnType();
       if (rt.isPrimitive()) {
           if (rt == boolean.class) return false;
           if (rt == byte.class) return (byte)0;
           if (rt == short.class) return (short)0;
           if (rt == int.class) return 0;
           if (rt == long.class) return 0L;
           if (rt == char.class) return '\0';
           if (rt == float.class) return 0f;
           if (rt == double.class) return 0d;
       }
       return null;
   }

   void addStub(Method method, Object returnValue) {
       stubs.put(method, returnValue);
   }

   void addStubMultiple(Method method, Object[] returns) {
       Queue<Object> q = new ArrayDeque<>(Arrays.asList(returns));
       stubs.put(method, q);
   }
}

class MockHandler implements InvocationHandler {
   private final Map<Method, Object> stubs = new HashMap<>();

   @Override
   public Object invoke(Object proxy, Method method, Object[] args) throws Throwable {
       // store invocation for when()
       SimpleMockito.lastInvocation.set(new SimpleMockito.Invocation(proxy, method, args, this));
       // if stub exists for method, return it
       if (stubs.containsKey(method)) {
           Object ret = stubs.get(method);
           // support multiple returns: if ret is Queue, poll.
           if (ret instanceof Queue) {
               return ((Queue<?>) ret).poll();
           }
           return ret;
       }
       // default return based on return type
       Class<?> rt = method.getReturnType();
       if (rt.isPrimitive()) {
           if (rt == boolean.class) return false;
           if (rt == byte.class) return (byte)0;
           if (rt == short.class) return (short)0;
           if (rt == int.class) return 0;
           if (rt == long.class) return 0L;
           if (rt == char.class) return '\0';
           if (rt == float.class) return 0f;
           if (rt == double.class) return 0d;
       }
       return null;
   }

   void addStub(Method method, Object returnValue) {
       stubs.put(method, returnValue);
   }

   void addStubMultiple(Method method, Object[] returns) {
       Queue<Object> q = new ArrayDeque<>(Arrays.asList(returns));
       stubs.put(method, q);
   }
}
